precheck.description: ensure public.folder is a table and public.project is absent
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid = c.reltype AND t.typrelid = c.oid
        WHERE c.oid = pg_catalog.to_regclass($1) AND c.relkind = 'r'
      ) AND pg_catalog.to_regclass($2) IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND t.typname = $3
      ) AS result

precheck.description: ensure chat.folderId is nullable text and chat.projectId is absent
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        WHERE a.attrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat')
          AND a.attname = $1 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attnum > 0
          AND a.atttypid = 'pg_catalog.text'::regtype AND NOT a.attnotnull
      ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        WHERE a.attrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat')
          AND a.attname = $2 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attnum > 0
      ) AS result

precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid
          AND a.attname = $4 AND NOT a.attisdropped
        WHERE c.conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass($1) AND c.conname = $2
          AND c.contype = $5 AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum]
          AND c.convalidated AND NOT c.condeferrable AND NOT c.condeferred
          AND ($5 = 'p' OR (
            c.confrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass($6)
            AND c.confkey = ARRAY[(SELECT attnum FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
              WHERE attrelid = c.confrelid AND attname = 'id' AND NOT attisdropped)]
            AND c.confdeltype = $7 AND c.confupdtype = 'c' AND c.confmatchtype = 's'
          ))
      ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass($1) AND conname = $3
      ) AS result

execute.description: lock chat and folder for the duration of the migration
execute.sql: LOCK TABLE "public"."chat", "public"."folder" IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

execute.description: revalidate the source state under DDL locks
execute.sql:
DO $rename$ BEGIN IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid = c.reltype AND t.typrelid = c.oid
        WHERE c.oid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder') AND c.relkind = 'r'
      ) AND pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.project') IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND t.typname = 'project'
      ) AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure public.folder is a table and public.project is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        WHERE a.attrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat')
          AND a.attname = 'folderId' AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attnum > 0
          AND a.atttypid = 'pg_catalog.text'::regtype AND NOT a.attnotnull
      ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        WHERE a.attrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat')
          AND a.attname = 'projectId' AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attnum > 0
      ) AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure chat.folderId is nullable text and chat.projectId is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid
          AND a.attname = 'id' AND NOT a.attisdropped
        WHERE c.conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder') AND c.conname = 'folder_pkey'
          AND c.contype = 'p' AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum]
          AND c.convalidated AND NOT c.condeferrable AND NOT c.condeferred
          AND ('p' = 'p' OR (
            c.confrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass(NULL)
            AND c.confkey = ARRAY[(SELECT attnum FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
              WHERE attrelid = c.confrelid AND attname = 'id' AND NOT attisdropped)]
            AND c.confdeltype = NULL AND c.confupdtype = 'c' AND c.confmatchtype = 's'
          ))
      ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder') AND conname = 'project_pkey'
      ) AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure folder_pkey has the expected definition and project_pkey is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid
          AND a.attname = 'userId' AND NOT a.attisdropped
        WHERE c.conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder') AND c.conname = 'folder_userId_fkey'
          AND c.contype = 'f' AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum]
          AND c.convalidated AND NOT c.condeferrable AND NOT c.condeferred
          AND ('f' = 'p' OR (
            c.confrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.user')
            AND c.confkey = ARRAY[(SELECT attnum FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
              WHERE attrelid = c.confrelid AND attname = 'id' AND NOT attisdropped)]
            AND c.confdeltype = 'c' AND c.confupdtype = 'c' AND c.confmatchtype = 's'
          ))
      ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder') AND conname = 'project_userId_fkey'
      ) AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure folder_userId_fkey has the expected definition and project_userId_fkey is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid
          AND a.attname = 'folderId' AND NOT a.attisdropped
        WHERE c.conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat') AND c.conname = 'chat_folderId_fkey'
          AND c.contype = 'f' AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum]
          AND c.convalidated AND NOT c.condeferrable AND NOT c.condeferred
          AND ('f' = 'p' OR (
            c.confrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder')
            AND c.confkey = ARRAY[(SELECT attnum FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
              WHERE attrelid = c.confrelid AND attname = 'id' AND NOT attisdropped)]
            AND c.confdeltype = 'n' AND c.confupdtype = 'c' AND c.confmatchtype = 's'
          ))
      ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat') AND conname = 'chat_projectId_fkey'
      ) AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure chat_folderId_fkey has the expected definition and chat_projectId_fkey is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid
          AND a.attname = 'userId' AND NOT a.attisdropped
        WHERE i.indexrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public."folder_userId_idx"')
          AND i.indrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder')
          AND c.relkind = 'i' AND am.amname = 'btree'
          AND i.indisvalid AND i.indisready AND i.indislive
          AND NOT i.indisunique AND i.indnatts = 1 AND i.indnkeyatts = 1
          AND i.indkey[0] = a.attnum AND i.indexprs IS NULL AND i.indpred IS NULL
      ) AND pg_catalog.to_regclass('public."project_userId_idx"') IS NULL AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure folder_userId_idx is the expected index and project_userId_idx is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid
          AND a.attname = 'folderId' AND NOT a.attisdropped
        WHERE i.indexrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public."chat_folderId_idx"')
          AND i.indrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.chat')
          AND c.relkind = 'i' AND am.amname = 'btree'
          AND i.indisvalid AND i.indisready AND i.indislive
          AND NOT i.indisunique AND i.indnatts = 1 AND i.indnkeyatts = 1
          AND i.indkey[0] = a.attnum AND i.indexprs IS NULL AND i.indpred IS NULL
      ) AND pg_catalog.to_regclass('public."chat_projectId_idx"') IS NULL AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure chat_folderId_idx is the expected index and chat_projectId_idx is absent';
    END IF;
IF (
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.conindid
        WHERE c.conrelid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder') AND c.conname = 'folder_pkey'
          AND c.contype = 'p' AND c.conindid = pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.folder_pkey')
          AND i.indrelid = c.conrelid AND i.indisprimary AND i.indisvalid
      ) AND pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.project_pkey') IS NULL AS result) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Folder rename precheck failed: ensure folder_pkey owns its primary index and project_pkey is absent';
    END IF; END $rename$
